before: Owner: 广西燃气集团有限公司. 拟建项目位于贺州市八步区、钟山县、平桂区、富川瑶族自治县、昭平县及梧州市蒙山县。项目新建信都分输站、富川分输站、昭平分输站各1座，新建阀室2座。新建DN273输气管道71.1千米，包括富川段、昭平段、信都段三部分：富川段长度39.6千米，设计压力4.0MPa，设计输气量0.2×108立方米/年；昭平段长度29.3千米，设计压力4.0MPa，设计输气量0.3×108立方米/年；信都段长度2.2千米，设计压力6.3MPa，设计输气量0.65×108立方米/年。项目总投资29888万元，其中环保投资约为891.88万元。
after: The Guangxi Development and Reform Commission approved the project on 17 July 2019. The approval names Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipeline Network Co as the project company. It covers about 100 km of new pipe: about 50 km in Linwei district, 32 km in Yangshuo county and 18 km in Lipu county. Design flow is 172 million cubic meters a year at 4 MPa, with pipe diameter D273.1. Total investment is about 346.04 million yuan. The approval lapses if work does not start within two years, unless an extension is granted. The note that was in this cell before described the Hezhou and Wuzhou project and was copied here by mistake.
